pages.name: Queen's Pawn: Krause, Reversed QGD
pages.notes: Plans 1-2 built an isolated queen's pawn on ...cxd4 exd4, which leaves White's c2-pawn beside d4, so no isolani; plan 3 named a lone d3 and a c3-b4 plan. Rewrote plans 1-3 around c4 and b3/Bb2. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: London
pages.notes: Overview called the f4-bishop light-squared. Plan 1 wrote the pawn triangle as a route, 0-0, and an h4-h5 attack; plan 2 lacked the line's real ideas (...Bf5/...Bg4 before ...e6, ...Qb6). British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: London
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the triangle as a route; plan 3 was an unprefixed both-sides plan with h3 against a bishop it does not touch; plan 4 had no side prefix. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: London
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked with f4 while the bishop stands on f4; plan 2 gave a ...b5-b4 expansion instead of the line's ...Bd6 and ...Qb6 ideas. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: London
pages.notes: Plan 2 used a semi-open c-file that does not exist yet; plan 3 put Black's ...Bxg3 in a White plan. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Torre Attack, Gossip Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the g5-bishop light-squared; plan 2 supported the knight with ...h5; plan 3 prepared f3 with a knight on f3; plan 4 named ...g5 with the bishop still on g5 and muddled whose king is weakened. Overview overclaimed the initiative. Rewrote all.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...e6 4.e3
pages.notes: Plan 3 named e5 as a pawn move. British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...g6 4.e3 Bg7 5.Nbd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the d2-knight on a d2-f1-g3 route as if from b1 and gave an h4-h5 attack. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...g6 4.e3 Bg7 5.Nbd2 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 played c4 where c3 and e4 is the set-up; plan 3 routed the knight d2-f1-e3 to reach e5, a square the f3-knight reaches at once; plan 4 named White's Bxf6 in a Black plan (first rewrite rejected for a false e4 claim; fixed and re-accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Torre Attack: 3...g6 4.e3 Bg7 5.Nbd2 O-O 6.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the rook lift as an Rf3-g3 route before castling; plan 2 called the g5-bishop light-squared and claimed Bxf6 damages Black's pawns; plan 4 gave a ...Nbd7-b6-c4 route. British spelling in the overview.
